description: Get one cited result from source_search. Input: the q and limit you passed to source_search and a result id. Returns source_url, text_fragment_url (a link that opens the quoted text), caller_verifies (a verification status: when true, open the link before relying on the text) and bearing, a proof token to pass unchanged to source_verify_bearing, or null. If the results have changed since your search, the call says so; run source_search again. A citation shows where the text is quoted from, not that the source's claim is true; a general web publisher is one account, not established fact.

id.description: The result id from source_search's results[] (a plain non-negative integer string)

limit.description: The exact limit value used in the originating source_search call

q.description: The exact query string used in source_search

name: source_fetch_fragment
title: Fetch one cited source fragment
